mission: THE DEPOSIT-MASS FORENSICS arming author_email_packet.md question 4 with measured numbers: the k-forensics-20260921 lane proved the deposit's macaque bone geometry is anatomically adult-female rhesus (femur 173.13 mm, tibia 156.81 mm vs Francis & Wang 2023), yet its packet flags the model's 0.772 kg pelvis+hindlimbs segment-mass sum as anomalous ('infant-class'). THIS LANE MEASURES THAT ANOMALY: (1) parse the deposit's per-body mass fields from the pinned Macaque_model.osim; (2) assemble the literature expectation: adult female rhesus body mass x primate hindlimb(+pelvis) mass-fraction band; (3) the comparison: measured vs expected, the deficit factor, and WHICH closing hypothesis the arithmetic supports - (a) density/placeholder template masses (the deposit's own 1 N muscle-force pattern), (b) mass set scaled by the SI geometry factor k = 0.119754 (linear or cube-law), (c) genuinely low; (4) a paste-ready 2-3 line APPEND amendment for packet question 4 (the packet file itself is never edited; amendment file lives in this lane dir).

rule0.statement: The deposit's mass set (0.772 kg pelvis+hindlimbs, packet question 4) is inconsistent with its own proven adult-female anatomy under literature mass fractions, and the INCONSISTENCY'S ARITHMETIC FINGERPRINT discriminates: a uniform/stamped mass set across bodies or across taxa = template placeholder (the 1 N force pattern); a single scaling arithmetic (linear k or cube-law k^3) closing exactly = scaled mass set; differentiated non-round masses with no scaling closure = genuinely low masses. THE THEORY: at adult female body mass 5.4-6.9 kg, primate hindlimb-chain fractions (18.5-24% of body mass, pelvis excluded, two independent pinned sources) put the expected pelvis+hindlimb mass at 0.997-1.656 kg, STRICTLY ABOVE the packet's 0.772 kg - so the packet's question 4 is answerable with measured numbers BEFORE the authors reply, and the amendment line's arithmetic must close against one of the three fingerprints.
rule0.prediction: (1) the parsed macaque body-mass sum reproduces the packet's 0.772 kg to within 0.0005 kg (the packet's own 3-decimal rounding); (2) 0.772 < 0.997 - the pre-registered expected envelope's MINIMUM - so the anomaly is real at the most conservative bound, deficit factor >= 1.29x, rising to >= 2.15x at the band top and higher with any pelvis mass; (3) neither scale reading closes: expected x k falls at 0.12-0.20 kg (3.9-6.5x BELOW 0.772) and expected x k^3 at ~0.002 kg (271-450x below); the inverse linear reading demands a 6.45 kg pelvis+hindlimb source mass (above the whole adult female band) and the cube-law inverse demands ~449 kg (no primate class); (4) the implied-body reading puts the mass set at a 3.22-4.18 kg animal - below the adult female band and above birth mass, i.e. immature-class; (5) the placeholder signature tests s1-s4 will show whether hypothesis (a) closes - pre-registered as OPEN, decided by the parse, not by this block; (6) the derivation is byte-deterministic.
rule0.falsifier: (a) the measured sum LANDING INSIDE OR ABOVE the expected envelope [0.997, 1.656] kg - the anomaly evaporates, packet question 4 loses its measured leg, and this lane records that verdict instead; (b) the parsed sum disagreeing with the packet's 0.772 by more than 0.0005 kg - a packet-number correction is recorded, never silently absorbed; (c) citation integrity - every number in the book and in the measured block cites a sha-pinned literature file, a manifest-verified deposit file, or a committed lane artifact; the de Leva pelvis fraction appears ONLY in the declared secondary context, never in the primary verdict; (d) non-deterministic rerun; (e) any file changed outside tools/science_funnel/validation/deposit_mass_20260921/; (f) any consumed .osim whose on-disk sha256 disagrees with its committed manifest entry (load REFUSES). Any hit is recorded as measured, never tuned.
